**Fix:** regenerated the `verbatim.allow` array for all 518 non-`required` verbatim entries across the 58 `docs/demos/*/i18n.json` files to include the full current locale set, then ran `vp check --fix` to format. Verified via [demo-i18n.test.ts](docs/scripts/demo-i18n.test.ts) and [tools/translation-adapters/tests/index.test.ts](tools/translation-adapters/tests/index.test.ts) (74 tests pass), plus a direct `resolveVerbatimAction` check.
